data.description: Contemporary Elegance with Sea and City Views
data.display_address: Kanyon by Beyond, Maritime City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover a lifestyle where contemporary elegance meets natural beauty at Kanyon in Dubai Maritime City. Designed by MAD, desertINK, and DWP, the tower’s distinctive silhouette features a double-layered façade, bronze aluminum slats, and a vertical green ribbon that unites urban sophistication with lush greenery.

Interiors are bathed in natural light, with wood, stone, and glass elements creating spaces of soft luxury. Expansive terraces open to captivating views of the sea, city, and future forest, fostering a unique connection between indoor living and the natural environment.

Kanyon offers premium amenities, including a triple-height lobby, infinity pool, spa, gym, and relaxation pavilions. Additional facilities include children’s play areas, a business lounge, and landscaped green retreats, providing an unmatched residential experience that combines comfort, convenience, and elegance.
